trigger_condition: Membership lookup fails after switching rooms while the previous learner ID remains set.
guard_snippet: const visibleStudentId = membership.scope === learnerLookupScope ? membership.studentId : null;
potential_consequence: Old learner identity drives new-room draft promotion or rejects the new room's valid checklist.

trigger_condition: Another membership invalidation arrives while a membership lookup is still pending.
potential_consequence: Overlapping requests invalidate usable responses; repeated events can indefinitely postpone learner discovery.

trigger_condition: A background notification follows a failed persisted target save.
guard_snippet: setReadError(null); // Keep mutationError until explicit retry or dismissal.
potential_consequence: Automatic reads erase the failed-save warning although the edit was never persisted.

trigger_condition: Saving edited text or notes exits editing before the asynchronous save fails.
guard_snippet: await onAddNote(item.id, noteText); setEditingNote(false); // Apply equivalent success handling to text.
potential_consequence: Effects overwrite the failed draft with saved values, preventing the user from retrying it.

trigger_condition: An outstanding checklist read never settles during a connection loss.
guard_snippet: saved = await readWithAbortTimeout(scope, 15000); // Release the serialized request on timeout.
potential_consequence: Manual Refresh and reconnect reconciliation remain queued behind the hung request indefinitely.
